passage_text: Moss had six boxes. The boxes were for nuts, and all six were still not full. Nell said she had seen the best bushes. She said they had hundreds of nuts. The bushes had five nuts. Nell said she had said five hundred. So they went to the big bushes. The bushes had branches, and the branches had nuts. They picked and picked. The boxes got fuller and the bushes got barer. Olive got out the dishes. She said nuts in boxes go soft, but nuts in dishes do not. They filled the dishes. Then they filled the boxes. Then they filled Moss. “Next time,” said Olive, “we get bigger boxes.”
